classification.difficultyReason: Form equal perimeter expressions from algebraic side lengths, then solve an equation with x on both sides.

content.prompt: The perimeter of rectangle ① is numerically equal to the perimeter of rectangle ②. Find the value of $x$.

spec.description: Two rectangles remain side by side, with circled identifiers 1 and 2 and all eight source right-angle markers. Decorative blue fills and outlines are replaced by unfilled figures with black marks under house style.
spec.mathematics: Rectangle 1 has horizontal length 2x cm and vertical length x cm. Rectangle 2 has horizontal length (x+2) cm and vertical length x cm. Drawn dimensions are schematic, not measurement data.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are visible; no solution values appear.
